requirements.text: The system shall allow a user to select an existing trend line and open its configuration dialog from the chart editing controls.
requirements.userStory: As a chart user, I want to open settings for a selected trend line so that I can modify the existing annotation.
preconditions: An existing trend line is visible on the trading chart.

acceptanceCriteria.given: An existing trend line is visible on the chart
acceptanceCriteria.when: The user selects the trend line
acceptanceCriteria.then: The trend line is highlighted with anchor handles and a contextual editing toolbar is displayed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: The trend line is selected and its contextual toolbar is visible
acceptanceCriteria.when: The user opens the trend line settings
acceptanceCriteria.then: A Trend Line dialog is displayed with the Style tab active and controls for Template, Cancel, and OK.

requirements.text: The system shall allow the user to configure the selected trend line's endpoint style, left and right extensions, and middle-point visibility, and apply those edits to the chart.
requirements.userStory: As a chart user, I want to adjust a trend line's style and geometry so that the annotation better supports my technical analysis.
preconditions: An existing trend line is selected.
The Trend Line settings dialog is open on the Style tab.

acceptanceCriteria.given: The Trend Line dialog is open on the Style tab
acceptanceCriteria.when: The user opens an endpoint-style selector
acceptanceCriteria.then: A menu displays Normal and Arrow endpoint-style options.

acceptanceCriteria.given: The Trend Line dialog is open on the Style tab
acceptanceCriteria.when: The user enables Extend left line, Extend right line, and Middle point
acceptanceCriteria.then: All three options are displayed as checked simultaneously.

acceptanceCriteria.given: Both extension options and the middle-point option are enabled
acceptanceCriteria.when: The user confirms the settings using OK
acceptanceCriteria.then: The dialog closes and the selected trend line is rendered beyond its original anchors with a visible middle point.

requirements.text: The system shall let the user configure a BRC-20 mint using a ticker, mint amount, and repeat-mint quantity, and shall enable progression when the entered configuration is accepted.
requirements.userStory: As a Web3 Wallet user, I want to configure a BRC-20 mint so that I can prepare the inscription transaction I intend to submit.
preconditions: The user is in the Inscription Center.
The BRC-20 Mint tab is selected.

acceptanceCriteria.given: The BRC-20 mint form is open with empty ticker and amount fields
acceptanceCriteria.when: The user has not completed the visible mint configuration
acceptanceCriteria.then: The form displays ticker, amount, and repeat-mint inputs, and the Next action is disabled.

acceptanceCriteria.given: The BRC-20 mint form is open
acceptanceCriteria.when: The user enters ticker DOGE, amount 4200, and repeat mint 1
acceptanceCriteria.then: The form displays DOGE, 4200, repeat mint 1, Minted: 1.88%, and an enabled Next action.

requirements.text: The system shall present a confirmation summary for the configured BRC-20 mint before submission.
requirements.userStory: As a Web3 Wallet user, I want to review the configured mint details so that I can verify the transaction before confirming it.
preconditions: The mint form shows ticker DOGE, amount 4200, and repeat mint 1.

acceptanceCriteria.given: The configured mint has ticker DOGE, amount 4200, and repeat mint 1
acceptanceCriteria.when: The user selects Next
acceptanceCriteria.then: A Web3 Wallet Confirm Mint sheet is displayed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: The Confirm Mint sheet is displayed
acceptanceCriteria.when: The user reviews the transaction summary
acceptanceCriteria.then: The sheet displays ticker DOGE, protocol BRC-20, amount 4,200, repeat mint 1, and UTXO value 330 sats multiplied by 1.

requirements.text: The system shall prevent mint confirmation when the wallet lacks sufficient Bitcoin balance or a suitable UTXO and shall expose the available recovery and exit actions shown in the blocked state.
requirements.userStory: As a Web3 Wallet user, I want blocking wallet conditions to be shown before submission so that I do not attempt a mint that cannot currently be funded.
preconditions: The Confirm Mint sheet is open.
The connected wallet has 0 Bitcoin available and no suitable UTXO can be selected.

acceptanceCriteria.given: The connected wallet has insufficient Bitcoin balance
acceptanceCriteria.when: The Confirm Mint sheet evaluates the wallet funding state
acceptanceCriteria.then: The sheet displays an insufficient-balance message, shows 0 Bitcoin available, and provides a Deposit action.

acceptanceCriteria.given: A suitable UTXO cannot be selected
acceptanceCriteria.when: The Confirm Mint sheet evaluates the transaction inputs
acceptanceCriteria.then: The sheet reports that a proper UTXO cannot be selected and suggests waiting for a network transaction to complete.

acceptanceCriteria.given: The confirmation sheet shows the insufficient-balance and unavailable-UTXO conditions
acceptanceCriteria.when: The user views the available transaction actions
acceptanceCriteria.then: Confirm is disabled and Cancel remains available.

requirements.text: The system shall allow users to select multiple recommended creators and follow the selected set through a count-aware primary action.
requirements.userStory: As a Feed user, I want to select and follow multiple recommended creators so that I can quickly personalize my Following feed.
preconditions: The user is viewing the creator-selection experience within the Following tab.
Recommended creator cards are available for selection.

acceptanceCriteria.given: The creator-selection experience is displayed
acceptanceCriteria.when: The user selects creator cards
acceptanceCriteria.then: Each selected creator card displays a visible check indicator.

acceptanceCriteria.given: One or more creator cards are selected
acceptanceCriteria.when: The selection count changes
acceptanceCriteria.then: The primary Follow CTA displays the current number of selected creators.

acceptanceCriteria.given: Ten creator cards are selected
acceptanceCriteria.when: The selection state is displayed
acceptanceCriteria.then: The primary CTA is visibly labeled “Follow (10).”

requirements.text: The system shall provide a dedicated Following feed containing shortcuts to followed creators and posts from followed accounts.
requirements.userStory: As a user who follows creators, I want a dedicated feed for their content so that I can browse posts from accounts I follow.
preconditions: The user has followed at least one creator.
The user is viewing the Feed destination with the Following tab active.

acceptanceCriteria.given: The user is viewing the Following feed
acceptanceCriteria.when: The feed is displayed
acceptanceCriteria.then: A horizontal row of followed-creator avatars is visible.

acceptanceCriteria.given: The user follows creators who have available content
acceptanceCriteria.when: The Following feed is displayed
acceptanceCriteria.then: A post from a followed creator is visible beneath the creator row.

acceptanceCriteria.given: The Following feed is open
acceptanceCriteria.when: The user views the bottom navigation
acceptanceCriteria.then: The Feed destination remains visibly selected.

requirements.text: The system shall provide a creator-management view where users can switch between currently followed creators and suggested creators, with relationship-specific actions shown for each account.
requirements.userStory: As a user, I want to review followed creators and browse suggested creators in one place so that I can manage and expand the accounts I follow.
preconditions: The user has opened the dedicated creator-management screen.

acceptanceCriteria.given: The creator-management screen is open
acceptanceCriteria.when: The Following tab is selected
acceptanceCriteria.then: The screen displays the current followed-creator list with a gray “Following” button for each visible account.

acceptanceCriteria.given: The creator-management screen is open
acceptanceCriteria.when: The user selects the Suggested Creators tab
acceptanceCriteria.then: The followed-creator list is replaced by suggested creator accounts.

acceptanceCriteria.given: The Suggested Creators tab is selected
acceptanceCriteria.when: Suggested accounts are displayed
acceptanceCriteria.then: Each visible suggested account has a yellow “Follow” action.

acceptanceCriteria.given: The creator-management screen is displayed
acceptanceCriteria.when: The user views its navigation controls
acceptanceCriteria.then: Both “Following” and “Suggested Creators” tabs are visible.
